title: Daily Entitlement Charge of the Credits Certified on a Restored Term
content:
**Charging scale — Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education), restoration of Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606 entitlement after a reduction.**

**Credits certified.** The credits certified for the restored term are those of the certifications whose term began in the twelve months before today: the credit hours of every term certification on the benefit with a term start in that period, added together.

**Daily charge of the credits certified**, against the restored term's full-time measure:

| Credits certified | Daily charge |
|---|---|
| Less than half of the full-time measure | 0.25 a day |
| At least half and less than three quarters of it | 0.5 a day |
| At least three quarters of it and less than all of it | 0.75 a day |
| At least the full-time measure | 1 a day |

**Both sides of each line (hypothetical, full-time measure of 12 credit hours: half is 6, three quarters is 9).**
- 5 credits: less than 6, charged 0.25; 6 credits: charged 0.5.
- 8 credits: less than 9, charged 0.5; 9 credits: charged 0.75.
- 11 credits: less than 12, charged 0.75; 12 credits: charged 1.

**Hypothetical twelve-month total.** A fall certification of 9 credits with a term start eight months ago and a spring certification of 3 credits with a term start three months ago are added: 12 credits certified, charged 1 a day against a measure of 12.
